title: Preserve an explicitly empty database Site snapshot

opportunity.rootCause: TryLoadSnapshot returned null both when the waf_sites table was missing and when the existing table contained zero rows.
opportunity.risk: After an operator deleted the last database-backed Site, startup could fall back to appsettings Sites and EnsureSeededAsync could resurrect a stale Site.

implementation.behavior: A successful waf_sites read always returns SiteConfigurationSnapshot, including an empty Sites list; null remains reserved for no connection string and UndefinedTable first-start migration compatibility.

red.result: failed 1/1 before implementation because the zero-row path returned null

verification.relatedRegression: passed 80/80 across empty-snapshot, bootstrap-failure, configuration, editor, persistence, activation, security, health-trend, UI-contract, and handoff classes

boundary: Live PostgreSQL empty-table startup execution was attempted but unavailable because 127.0.0.1:5432 was not listening

Authenticated browser/published-EXE smoke, visual responsive/screen-reader verification, CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration testing, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode signing, and production certification remain unverified
